coverage.summary: Riverglades contains more than 150 new quests spanning much of the mid-30s to mid-40s experience range. Individual quest names, IDs, objectives, rewards, and NPC relationships are not yet populated.
Blizzard describes more than 1,000 new quests woven throughout the level 1-60 journey, including additions to starting zones and new regions.
Official material confirms new NPCs, quests, profession hooks, recipes, and smaller story moments across starting-zone experiences. Individual quest records remain pending.
Wetlands receives new quests and additional opportunities to develop existing characters and stories. Exact quest records remain pending.
The Desolace centaur faction questlines are expanded with new content and rewards, while Shen'dralas adds a new area tied to Eldre'Thalas. Individual records remain pending.

Forsaken Paladin content includes a story rooted in Tirisfal Glades and a level-60 personal quest for an epic mount. Individual quest names, IDs, objectives, rewards, and NPC relationships require separate source support.

data_rules: Forever quest records must be researched as Forever content and must not silently inherit Classic quest rewards or coordinates.
Aggregate coverage records may document confirmed scope before individual quests are verified.
Do not invent quest IDs, objectives, rewards, NPC locations, or level requirements.
When individual quests are added, connect them to zone_id, giver_npc_id, reward_item_ids, reward_currency_ids, and source_ids whenever the source supports those relationships.
